section.sectionSummaryBrief: There are two aspects to the future clothing of miracles within nature: that the supernatural will be clothed in nature, and that nature will not conceal the miracles.
section.t: And it can be said,
that in the clothing of wonders within nature that will be in the future,
there are two matters.
That the wonders that are above nature will be clothed in nature is because then also the concealment that is above revelation will be drawn into revelation.
And that nature will not conceal the wonders is because then there will be an elevation of nature,
that even nature will be a vessel for the wonders that are above nature.

Based on this, we can explain the connection between the two interpretations of "I will show him wonders" — the interpretation of the Mitteler Rebbe that even the wonders above nature will then be seen in revelation
(and not like now, when only the existence of wonders above nature is known),
and the interpretation of the Tzemach Tzedek that even in the miracles clothed in nature
(great wonders drawn from the aspect of Levado [Alone]),
the miracle within them will be seen in revelation
(as above in section 3)
— because the content of the two interpretations is that in the future, nature will be a vessel for that which is above nature,
therefore nature will not conceal the miracles clothed within it.
However, according to the interpretation of the Tzemach Tzedek,
the matter of "I will show him wonders" is that nature will not conceal the miracles that are related to nature
(that is,
the miracles drawn from the fact that Ein Sof is below, below, etc.,
the matter of the revelation of Ein Sof).
For nature as it is now conceals even these miracles.
Because the root of the miracles clothed in nature is in the revelation of Ein Sof,
which in general is the Name Havayah, which is above nature,
and the root of nature is from the Name Elokim
(Elokim has the numerical value of haTeva [nature]37)
which conceals and hides the Name Havayah.
And in the future, the Name Elokim will be a vessel for the revelation of Havayah.
And according to the interpretation of the Mitteler Rebbe,
the matter of "I will show him wonders" is that nature, drawn from the Name Elokim, will be a vessel
(also)
for the wonders above nature, drawn from the fact that Ein Sof is above, above, etc.,
the concealment that is above revelation
(above Havayah).

section.sectionSummaryBrief: In the Exodus from Egypt, the channel for the future redemption was opened, providing the power for the future "I will show him wonders" through the work of refinement.
section.t: And based on what was brought above
(from the maamar)
that in the redemption of the Exodus from Egypt, the channel for the future redemption was also opened,
it can be said,
that in the redemption of the Exodus from Egypt, there was also drawn the empowering for the matter of "I will show him wonders" that will be in the future redemption.
And the explanation is,
that this — that in the future nature will be a vessel for that which is above nature
[the matter of "I will show him wonders"]
— is through the refinements (birurim),
through which the world is refined and elevated and becomes a vessel for that which is above nature.
For the beginning of the matter of refinements was in the Exodus from Egypt.
For through our being slaves to Pharaoh in Egypt38
[Pharaoh — a harsh king,
in Egypt — a harsh country,
from which39
a slave cannot escape40]
and nevertheless they withstood the trial,
through this they refined the sparks that were in Egypt.
And even to the point of "and they emptied out Egypt"41,
making it like a net without fish and like a sieve without grain42,
and through this the power was given for the work of refinements in all the days after the Exodus from Egypt
(days, in the plural),
including also the days of the time of exile.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Mentioning the Exodus daily adds power to the daily work of refinement, bringing the world closer to being a vessel for the revelation of "I will show him wonders" in the future.
section.t: And it can be said,
that one of the reasons we mention the Exodus from Egypt every day is that through this, there is an addition to the empowering drawn from the Exodus for the work of refinements each day.
And through each and every day refining more and more sparks,
we draw closer to the coming of Moshiach,
for through each spark that is refined,
the world becomes more purified,
until, at the completion of the refinements, the world will be a vessel for the revelation of G-dliness that is above worlds,
which in general is that the nature of the world will be a vessel for that which is above nature,
"I will show him wonders."
And therefore they will mention the Exodus from Egypt even in the days of Moshiach,
because this — that then the world will be a vessel for the revelation of G-dliness that is above worlds — is through the redemption of the Exodus from Egypt.
And this is "As in the days of your exodus from the land of Egypt, I will show him wonders,"
that this statement that "I will show him wonders"
(in the future)
will be "as in the days of your exodus from the land of Egypt" means,
that the empowering for the matter of "I will show him wonders" that will be in the future is from the Exodus from Egypt.
And it is precise: "as the days of your exodus,"
"days" in the plural,
for in the Exodus from Egypt there was only the empowering for the matter of "I will show him wonders,"
and in order for the matter of "I will show him wonders" to be drawn into actuality, it is through the work of refinements in the days between the Exodus from Egypt and the future redemption,
which are "the days of your exodus from the land of Egypt"
(as above in section 1 of the maamar),
"days" in the plural.
